# age_identity (Resource)

Generates an age X25519 identity (private key) and its recipient (public key).

The identity is generated once and kept in state, so it stays stable across plans. To rotate it, replace the resource (`tofu apply -replace=...`) or change `keepers`.

~> **Note:** the identity is stored in state. Use encrypted state or a backend you trust with secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "age_identity" "backup" {}

# Rotate by bumping the keeper (or with `tofu apply -replace=age_identity.backup`).
resource "age_identity" "rotating" {
  keepers = {
    rotation = "1"
  }
}

output "backup_recipient" {
  value = age_identity.backup.recipient
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that, when changed, generate a new identity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `recipient`.
- `identity` (String, Sensitive) The identity, `AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...`. This is the format of an age identity file.
- `recipient` (String) The recipient, `age1...`. Pass it to `age_encrypted.recipients`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the identity itself. Prefer an import block fed from a
# sensitive source, so the key doesn't end up in your shell history.
tofu import age_identity.backup AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...
```
